kurz: A stock is flavour simmered out of bones, meat and vegetables. The gelatine in it makes sauces silky when reduced.
bild_im_kopf: Like a store of flavour and body laid up in liquid in advance.
was_passiert: As bones simmer for a long time, [[kollagen-gelatine|collagen]] dissolves into gelatine. A good stock sets in the fridge. When reduced, the gelatine concentrates and thickens the sauce without starch.
faustregeln: Only let stock simmer gently; then it stays clear.
Shop-bought stock often has little gelatine: help it along with butter or a little starch.
